Problem 1 
#Part a 
```{r}
#install.packages("rvest")
#install.packages("janitor")
library(rvest)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)

wiki_link <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_FIS_Alpine_Ski_World_Cup_women%27s_champions"
webpage <- read_html(wiki_link)
all_tables <- html_elements(webpage, "table") |> html_table(fill = TRUE)

overall_table <- all_tables[[1]] %>% 
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)

top_three_rows <- overall_table %>% slice_head(n = 3)
top_three_rows
```
#Part b
```{r}
clean_overall <- overall_table %>%
  mutate(
    `1st` = str_trim(str_remove_all(`1st`, "\\(.*\\)")),
    `2nd` = str_trim(str_remove_all(`2nd`, "\\(.*\\)")),
    `3rd` = str_trim(str_remove_all(`3rd`, "\\(.*\\)"))
  )
clean_overall
```
#Part c
```{r}

  select(Year, Overall, Downhill, `Super-G`, `Giant slalom`, Slalom, Combined, Parallel) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ str_remove_all(.x, "\\(.*\\)"))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), str_trim))
event_table
```

Problem 2
#Part a
```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

api_key <- "88e2476437754986a18b23b19d9986a8"

endpoint <- "https://api.spoonacular.com/recipes/complexSearch" #got this from documentation on website

params <- list(
  cuisine = "Italian",
  maxCarbs = 30,
  number = 100, 
  addRecipeNutrition = "true",
  apiKey = api_key
)

response <- GET(endpoint, query = params)

data <- fromJSON(content(response, as = "text"))
```
#Part b
```{r}
recipes <- data$results %>%
  mutate(
    carbs = map_dbl(nutrition$nutrients, function(nutrients) {
      nutrient <- nutrients[nutrients$name == "Carbohydrates", ]
      if (nrow(nutrient) > 0) nutrient$amount else NA_real_
    })
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(carbs)) %>%
  arrange(carbs) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  transmute(
    Recipe = title,
    ID = id,
    Carbs = carbs
  )

print(recipes)
```
#Part c
```{r}
wine_url <- "https://api.spoonacular.com/food/wine/recommendation" #got this from documentation on website

wine_params <- list(
  wine = "riesling",
  maxPrice = 50,
  number = 10,
  apiKey = api_key
)

wine_response <- GET(wine_url, query = wine_params)
wine_data <- fromJSON(content(wine_response, as = "text"))

wines <- wine_data$recommendedWines %>%
  transmute(
    Title = title,
    ID = id,
    Price = price
  )

print(wines)
```

Problem 3
#Part a
```{r}
library(gutenbergr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

stevenson_titles <- gutenberg_metadata %>%
  filter(author == "Stevenson, Robert Louis") %>%
  filter(str_detect(title, "Treasure Island|Jekyll"))

stevenson_titles %>%
  select(gutenberg_id, title, language)
```
#Part b
```{r}
library(gutenbergr)
library(dplyr)

books <- gutenberg_download(c(27780, 43), meta_fields = "title")

unique(books$title)
```
#Part c
```{r}
library(tidytext)
library(tibble)

data("stop_words")

top_words <- books %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(title, word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(title) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 10)

top_words
```
#Part d
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

word_props <- books %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  count(title, word) %>%
  group_by(title) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
  select(title, word, proportion) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = title, values_from = proportion, values_fill = 0)

correlation <- cor(
  word_props$`Treasure Island`,
  word_props$`The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde`
)

cat("Correlation:", correlation, "\n")
```
```{r}
ggplot(word_props, aes(x = `Treasure Island`, y = `The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde`)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Similarity/Dissimilarity between proportion of non-stop words",
    x = "Treasure Island",
    y = "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
word_props %>%
  filter(`The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde` > 0.001,
         `Treasure Island` < 0.0001) %>%
  arrange(desc(`The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde`)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2)
```
```{r}
word_props %>%
  filter(`Treasure Island` > 0.001,
         `The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde` < 0.0001) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Treasure Island`)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2)
```
```{r}
word_props %>%
  filter(`Treasure Island` > 0.001,
         `The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde` > 0.001) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Treasure Island` + `The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde`)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2)
```
#Part e
```{r}
treasure_bigrams <- books %>%
  filter(title == "Treasure Island") %>%
  unnest_tokens(pair, text, token = "ngrams", n = 2)

library(tidyr)

clean_bigrams <- treasure_bigrams %>%
  separate(pair, into = c("first_word", "second_word"), sep = " ") %>%
  filter(!first_word %in% stop_words$word,
         !second_word %in% stop_words$word) %>%
  unite(bigram, first_word, second_word, sep = " ")

top_10_bigrams <- clean_bigrams %>%
  count(bigram, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_10_bigrams
```

Problem 4 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(textdata)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```
```{r}
library(gutenbergr)

books <- gutenberg_download(c(27780, 43), meta_fields = "title")

data("stop_words")

book_words <- books %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word")

jekyll_words <- book_words %>% filter(title == "The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde")
treasure_words <- book_words %>% filter(title == "Treasure Island")
```
#Part a
```{r}
fear_words <- get_sentiments("nrc") %>%
  filter(sentiment == "fear")

top_fear_words <- jekyll_words %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  inner_join(fear_words, by = "word") %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

print(top_fear_words)
```
#Part b
```{r}
afinn_lexicon <- get_sentiments("afinn")

strongest_negatives <- treasure_words %>%
  inner_join(afinn_lexicon, by = "word") %>%
  arrange(value) %>%  
  slice_head(n = 10)

print(strongest_negatives)
```

#Part c
```{r}
bing_lexicon <- get_sentiments("bing")

jekyll_sentiments <- jekyll_words %>%
  inner_join(bing_lexicon, by = "word") %>%
  count(sentiment) %>%
  mutate(book = "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde")

treasure_sentiments <- treasure_words %>%
  inner_join(bing_lexicon, by = "word") %>%
  count(sentiment) %>%
  mutate(book = "Treasure Island")

sentiment_counts <- bind_rows(jekyll_sentiments, treasure_sentiments)

ggplot(sentiment_counts, aes(x = sentiment, y = n, fill = sentiment)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~book) +
  labs(title = "Sentiment Comparison with Bing Lexicon", x = NULL, y = "Word Count") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1000)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
